title: Prompt Builder
body: A good prompt has three parts: a role for the AI, a clear task, and some context about you and your work. Build one below and watch it assemble live.
instruction: Pick or type a role, a task and some context. Your finished prompt appears at the bottom, ready to copy.
_whyText: Naming a role, a task and your context gives the AI enough to answer usefully — vague prompts get vague replies.

_parts.label: Role
_parts.help: Who should the AI act as?

_starterGroups.label: Level 4 (first year)
items: a patient tutor who explains things in plain language
a study-skills coach helping me get started

_starterGroups.label: Level 5–6 (later years)
items: an academic in [subject] who knows the current debates
a critical friend who challenges my reasoning

_parts.label: Task
_chips: Give me feedback on my draft.

_starterGroups.label: Understand
items: Explain [concept] in plain language for someone new to it.
Use an everyday analogy to explain [concept].

_starterGroups.label: Be critical
items: Set out the limits of [theory] and the alternatives.

_parts.label: Context
_parts.help: Tell it about you and your work.
